name: Formic acid; electrochemical reduction of CO2; at plant
description: The functional unit for this model is one kilogram of formic acid produced via the electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide. The system boundary is cradle to gate and includes raw material extraction, manufacturing, and transport. The carbon dioxide is from captured carbon dioxide, the capturing and transporting impacts are not included. Electrode production via drop casting method and carbon dioxide electroylzer cell for conversion are included. The inventory is based on experimental data from a lab-scale electrochemical cell. (Banu et al., 2023).

processDocumentation.timeDescription: This data is from a lab-scale experiment and thus is not representative of a specific time period. The lifetime of the study is stated as 10 years in the original report.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: The electricity grid and incoming materials are representative of the US.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Formic acid production from electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide. For detailed information, review section 2 of the source paper - Banu et al., 2023.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Data taken from LCI tables 2 and 3 from the source study.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Treatment of missing data and mass balance are not explicitly discussed in the source study.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data is from a lab scale study.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: No data treatment was applied between the source study and this inventory.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Data was collected from the source study.
